card.name: Joiners right before a following term
card.fires_on: Short joining marks or words (and, of, a colon, a slash, a space) that sit right before the next term. Seen after FTC in HIV drug lists, after development in resistance wording, and in web server paths and config text.

modes.label: After FTC
modes.description: The word 'and' or '/or' right after the abbreviation FTC, before tenofovir or TDF.
modes.example: have discontinued products containing FTC<< and>>/or tenofovir disoprox

modes.label: Before resistance
modes.description: The word 'of' after development, just before resistance.
modes.example: loss of virologic response and development<< of>> resistance. Hepatitis C Antiviral

modes.label: Server paths and config
modes.description: A slash or colon in Apache or Linux directory text, just before the next path or tag.
modes.example: Apache by default serves files from<< />>var/www/html/.
